value.title: Cross-model review — 007-human-interface
value.note:
Pinned review basis: 4a0419e3178b2f008f2419dedf489343e1a52791. Interim verdict: REQUEST_CHANGES.

Acceptance criteria at this basis:
- ac-0001 — FALSE as written: pipe/default, pipe/--human, pipe/--json, and pipe/FS3_OUTPUT are tested, but the promised PTY-backed no-flag and --json cases are not asserted per covered verb.
- ac-0002 — TRUE under its amended scope: 12 daemon-computed answer cases and the zero-byte usage-error case retain pre-plan bytes; docs list and agents-start-here are explicitly shape-only. Two captured golden files were deleted with a recorded ruling; none was re-captured.
- ac-0003 — PARTIALLY PROVEN: live TUI, real activity, search, stale-state behavior, and terminal restoration have evidence; the explicit SSH leg was not independently exercised.
- ac-0004 — TRUE for the exercised contract: NDJSON framing, hello-first, concurrent watcher identity, producer-side slow-consumer drop, settlements, root changes, and TUI live consumption passed. The human watch version gate and TUI-local backpressure defects below remain.
- ac-0005 — TRUE: AGENTS.md (and its CLAUDE.md symlink), the bundled flowspace skill, agents-start-here, and self-teaching docs carry the TTY/JSON rule; the direct agent front door returned the expected JSON envelope.
- ac-0006 — NOT YET TRUE against current main: the composed basis predates main's quiet-EPIPE change and must reconcile it; final harness checks must be rerun on the repaired clean SHA.

Composition seams:
1. Renderer decline path — PASS. fs3_cli::render::render returns None for unknown/malformed payloads and emit falls back to serialized JSON; targeted tests passed. Output selection has one product decision call at crates/cli/src/main.rs:413-418.
2. TUI fixture-to-live swap — PASS. Production event_source calls DaemonClient::events; the fixture is test-only; Unknown kinds are retained by serde and skipped by the UI.
3. Renderer/event-wire agreement — PARTIAL. Both use fs3_core::events and the stderr-only meter preserves stdout, but the meter does not isolate the requested root and can display concurrent work from another root.

Independent commands observed: cargo test -p fs3-cli --test envelope_goldens (2 passed); cargo test -p fs3-cli --test render_output --test status_watch --test envelope_goldens (8 passed); cargo test -p fs3-core (139 tests/doc-tests passed); cargo test -p fs3-cli --lib (45 passed); FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL=.../flowspace3_test cargo test -p fs3-daemon --test event_stream (7 passed). The first harness checks attempt correctly refused without FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL; the isolated rerun raced the PM's latest-main merge and is discarded, not evidence.

value.finding: Resolved during review — the branch had deleted two captured golden files while first-light claimed no golden was modified. Evidence: `git diff 15f6982..HEAD -- crates/cli/tests/goldens/ crates/cli/tests/envelope_goldens.rs` deleted stdout/docs-list.stdout and stdout/agents-start-here.stdout and replaced byte equality with shape checks. What would make it false: the criterion and transcript explicitly name the exemption, deletion, retained witnesses, and no-recapture distinction. Commit 4a0419e does so; the exemption is accepted because editorial documentation bytes intentionally change under ac-0005.

The composed basis regresses main's quiet broken-pipe contract. Evidence: `git diff main..4a0419e -- crates/cli/src/main.rs crates/cli/tests/epipe.rs` removes fallible writers/EPIPE handling from main commit 086f812; an independent 8 MiB envelope probe that read one stdout byte then closed returned 101 and stderr `panicked ... failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe`. What would make it false: reconcile the EPIPE behavior through the human/JSON seam, retain the main epipe test, and make the same probe exit 0 with empty stderr.
value.receipt: Probe returncode=101; panic names Broken pipe (os error 32).

value.finding: ac-0001's real-binary four-case matrix has no TTY leg. Evidence: crates/cli/tests/render_output.rs:128-154 defines Default, HumanFlag, JsonUnderHumanEnv, HumanEnv, and every command uses Command::output(), so stdout is always piped; first-light exercises only status under a PTY. What would make it false: PTY-backed real-binary cases for every covered verb prove TTY/no-flag -> human and TTY/--json -> JSON; the existing tests already cover pipe/no-flag and pipe/--human.
value.receipt: Targeted render_output suite passed 4/4 but contains no PTY allocation.

value.finding: The add/scan meter can display another concurrent root's progress. Evidence: main.rs:436,455 calls while_pending without the requested path; render/progress.rs:20-23,68,75-89 draws every broadcast ScanProgress and applies no root/root_path filter. What would make it false: pass the canonical requested root to the consumer, filter root_path, and test interleaved events from two roots.
value.receipt: Source trace across the composed seam; global broadcast contract confirmed in AppState.

value.finding: The daemon's bounded slow-consumer policy is lost after the TUI decodes the socket. Evidence: tui.rs:49 uses unbounded std::sync::mpsc::channel and run_loop at 72 drains until empty before drawing or polling input. A sustained stream can grow memory or starve repaint/input even though the daemon's per-subscriber queue is bounded. What would make it false: bounded/coalesced local delivery or a per-frame drain budget, with a flood test proving repaint and quit remain responsive.
value.receipt: Source trace; daemon-side 7/7 stream tests do not exercise this post-decode queue.

value.finding: status --watch --human accepts incompatible stream versions instead of refusing them. Evidence: watch.rs:46-56 parses and prints Hello without checking STREAM_NAME/STREAM_VERSION and does not check Event.v; a v2 hello plus v2 event probe exited 0 and rendered both. What would make it false: human watch validates hello and event versions like the TUI decoder, while JSON watch remains raw passthrough, and an incompatible-v integration test fails with a named error.
value.receipt: Probe returncode=0; stdout began `watching fs3.events v2`; stderr empty.

value.finding: The duplicate-diagnosis fix drops all envelope messages in human mode. Evidence: main.rs:686-690 emits messages only when no screen rendered, while no renderer reads envelope.messages; a status --human probe using the existing messages.json fixture returned 0 but the standing update message appeared in neither stdout nor stderr. What would make it false: render standing messages exactly once in human mode, suppress only the duplicate failure diagnosis, and add a human status-with-messages integration assertion.

The human-render service snap-in recipe drifted after event authentication was centralized. Evidence: docs/services/human-render.md:33 prescribes while_pending(client.base_url(), future), while render/progress.rs:20-23 requires &DaemonClient and main passes &client. What would make it false: update the recipe to the authenticated client signature.
value.receipt: Direct comparison of service contract to shipped signature.

value.rationale: Commit 4a0419e corrected the criterion and evidence claim; the explicitly ruled shape-only exception is coherent with editorial payloads.
Independently reproduced on the pinned binary; blocking until quiet EPIPE behavior is restored.
The test matrix's process stdout is always a pipe; the criterion explicitly requires TTY assertions.
The progress consumer has no operation identity even though the broadcast carries all roots.
The post-decode channel is unbounded and exhaustively drained before UI work.
An incompatible-version stream was accepted and rendered successfully.
The existing messages fixture was invisible on both output streams in human mode.
The documented call no longer matches the implementation and bypasses the authenticated seam's intent.
